snippet.title: Ground Zero - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Explore a shattered South Korea in Ground Zero, a retro survival horror set two months after a catastrophic meteor impact. You play as elite operative Seo-Yeon backed by her Canadian partner, sent into the fog-filled ruins of Busan to investigate what really happened.

Fight terrifying mutants mutated by fallout. Solve puzzles in atmospheric fixed-camera scenes. Upgrade your gear with Genome Points earned from clean kills. Explore shoreline towns, temples and Korea’s urban centre as you uncover truth, face massive bosses and unlock hidden endings. This is survival horror re-imagined.

Wishlist Ground Zero now on Steam to discover the mystery when it drops.
